translations.web: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and shake his head.
translations.bsb: They have made their land a desolation, a perpetual object of scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and shake their heads.
translations.kjv: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
translations.asv: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and shake his head.
